name: Terminator
tagline: A game where an AI overlord coordinates shooting, strategy and scoring agents fast enough to fight you in real time.
problem: Many multi-agent applications are impractical because LLM inference is too slow.
solution: A browser game in which specialised agents run on very fast inference and an orchestrator directs them live over websockets.
demo_moment: Team-described: play against agents that react to you in real time.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Cerebus - Best use of Cerebras” among 85 submissions.
Built to show something only fast inference makes possible.

lessons: Show a sponsor's speed advantage as gameplay people can feel.
